Infeasible due to HC-03: Two course sections assigned to the same instructor share the exact same time slot TS-CLASH.
Feasible under P50 expected demand (40 students), but demonstrates an extreme demand spike where P90 (120 students) triples P50, testing capacity risk planning.
Feasible on boundary: Faculty load exactly equals max_weekly_load_hours (12.0h), max_courses (3), and max_preparations (2) with zero slack.
